prompt: Objective: find why an engineering consultancy's margin fell from 18% to 9%. What you've learned: revenue grew 20%. Latest finding: headcount grew 45%, mostly junior engineers. What is the best next step?

options.text: Find out why revenue grew only 20%
options.feedback: Revenue grew; the margin fell because costs grew faster.

options.text: Compare revenue per engineer before and after the hiring
options.feedback: Right. Hiring outran revenue. Revenue per engineer shows whether the new hires are billing enough yet.

options.text: Compare office costs with industry benchmarks
options.feedback: The finding points to headcount, not office costs.

options.text: Estimate savings from cutting a third of junior engineers this year
options.feedback: That jumps to a fix before knowing whether the hires are ramping up.

explanation: Headcount grew 45%, mostly junior engineers, against 20% revenue growth. Check revenue per engineer before and after.
